text:
Japan’s real, PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose about twelvefold from 1950 to 2016. Standard Maddison Project series put the gain at roughly 11–14 times, from a few thousand constant international dollars in 1950 to the mid-to-high $30,000s by 2016, with most of the rise occurring before the early-1990s slowdown.

CONFIDENCE: 68
